parameters.name: ApplicationFederatedCredentialName
parameters.description: The name of the application federated identity credential.

parameters.name: ApplicationFederatedCredentialType
parameters.description: The type of the application federated identity credential.

parameters.name: OidcVerificationConfig
parameters.description: The OIDC structured configuration. This parameter applies when the verification mode is structured and the credential type is oidc.

parameters.name: Pkcs7VerificationConfig
parameters.description: The PKCS#7 structured configuration. This parameter applies when the verification mode is structured and the credential type is pkcs7.

parameters.name: VerificationMode
parameters.description:
The verification mode. Valid values:

- freedom (default)
- structured
